name: Return to Podrig
summary: At the Undercity, you receive a crate of weapons for the Sepulcher after delivering a dispatch to the capital. Forsaken bats carry you across Lordaeron to Deathguard Podrig.

sections.title: The Undercity Supply Line
sections.body: Deathguard Podrig's garrison at the Sepulcher needs a steady supply of weapons from the Undercity. In Silverpine Forest, its sentries face worgen, Dalaran remnants, and Scourge stragglers. Fresh armaments help the Forsaken hold the region and keep the outpost ready.

sections.title: Wings of the Forsaken
sections.body: Bat Master Michael Garrett tends the central roost in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. Forsaken bats know the way back to the capital, but you speak with local handlers such as Karos Razok before arranging a flight to a distant outpost. Carrying Gordon's Crate across Lordaeron links the Undercity's supplies with its scattered strongholds.

aliases: what am i delivering to podrig
faq.answer: Gordon's Crate holds fresh weapons made in the Undercity for the Deathguards at the Sepulcher, who face threats nearby.
Deathguard Podrig is a Forsaken soldier stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He oversees the garrison's supplies and defenses.
Michael Garrett is the Forsaken bat master at the Undercity's Trade Quarter. He coordinates flight paths across Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why do you have to speak to a bat master before flying somewhere?
faq.answer: Forsaken bats know the way back to the central roost in the Undercity. For an outward flight, you first establish a route with a regional handler so the bat can reach its destination safely.

faq.q: Why is the Sepulcher so important to supply?
faq.answer: The Sepulcher is the Forsaken's main forward base in Silverpine Forest. It anchors their presence against worgen packs, Moonrage threats, and Dalaran forces in the area.
Karos Razok is the bat master at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He manages the roosted bats that connect the outpost to the Undercity.

angles.text: As an undead, you help keep forward garrisons armed to defend Lordaeron and secure Queen Sylvanas's fledgling realm.
As a member of the Horde, you help sustain the supply routes connecting the Undercity to remote outposts across the northern continent.
